overview: Jenny Graham and Matt Rice discussed Design Option C 2.2 for the Medford High School building project, focusing on its vertical layout, construction phasing, and traffic flow benefits.

items.title: Design Features of Option C 2.2
items.summary: Matt Rice explained that Option C 2.2 offers a more compact building design that climbs up the hillside with the topography, potentially reaching up to six stories.

items.title: Minimizing Construction Impact on Students
items.summary: Rice addressed concerns about construction impacts by proposing to build new sections off the existing footprint and optimizing classroom usage to minimize the need for modular classrooms.

items.title: Site Layout and Traffic Circulation
items.summary: The discussion highlighted how the plan places a synthetic turf field over a large parking area to optimize site space and streamline traffic circulation.

subject: High School Design Option C 2.2 Review
